page.layout: One printed bookplate (ex libris) pasted on a marbled cover; the engraving and banner text are at the centre, the signature below the banner. No other printed text on the page.
page.notes: The bookplate shows an engraving of a church or abbey with towers, and a seated scholar in a long robe at a desk with an open book, a closed book at the left, and a scroll banner below. The banner reads MENTE LIBERA; "GES" appears at the right end of the banner, and "CHAMPEL" is the artist's signature at the lower right. The marbled cover, gilt border and dark background are not printed text and are not transcribed.
